retrieval_tool: web.run open and find; direct official Android references
scope: Selected independently retrieved public reference facts, not archived full pages or runtime evidence. All named API floors also independently checked against installed official SDK metadata in command-1.stdout.txt.

findings.finding: The public high-contrast read and listener registration are API36. The reference notes that custom rendering needs this query; use of native TextViews alone does not establish the authored V2 appearance satisfies the shared contract.

The public query is API34. Documented values lie between -1 and 1 inclusive, with default contrast at zero. This supports a finite exact-neutral admission policy instead of rejecting positive values only.
The adjustment and undefined sentinel are API31. Undefined data is distinct from a known zero; rejecting it is a selected strict policy, not evidence of unchanged prior admission.
The typed query is API30. Legacy system-window insets describe obscuration by system windows including IME; exact equivalence to the typed V2 mask is not established.
The API30 aggregate excludes IME and displayCutout. V2 adds displayCutout explicitly. Combining legacy readings is not demonstrated equivalent to that current-window typed query.
The reference cautions that fontScale is informational under nonlinear scaling and directs conversion through TypedValue. Preserve actual platform conversion rather than a uniform coefficient.

The no-default overload is API17 and throws SettingNotFoundException for an absent or nonnumeric value. The defaulting overload returns its supplied default in those cases. A public nondefaulting observation is available at the proposed baseline.
